potential_operation_identity: CREATE TABLE potential_operation_identity (potential_operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL, origin_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
potential_operation_evidence_association: CREATE TABLE potential_operation_evidence_association (association_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, potential_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_key TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_type TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('INCLUDED','EXCLUDED','UNRESOLVED','CONTRADICTORY')), rationale_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(potential_operation_id,evidence_key,evidence_type,state))
potential_operation_assessment_version: CREATE TABLE potential_operation_assessment_version (assessment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, potential_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_digest TEXT NOT NULL, freshness_key TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(potential_operation_id,evidence_digest))
potential_operation_current: CREATE TABLE potential_operation_current (potential_operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL, freshness_key TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
potential_operation_assessment_lineage:
CREATE TABLE potential_operation_assessment_lineage(
 assessment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, potential_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 pipeline_lineage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(pipeline_lineage IN ('LEGACY_CANDIDATE_SPECIFIC','GENERIC_DECLARATIVE_V2')),
 pipeline_version TEXT NOT NULL, source_contract_version TEXT,
 association_contract_version TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(assessment_id) REFERENCES potential_operation_assessment_version(assessment_id))
potential_operation_assessment_associati:
CREATE TABLE potential_operation_assessment_association_binding(
 assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL, association_id TEXT NOT NULL, association_contract_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(assessment_id,association_id), FOREIGN KEY(assessment_id) REFERENCES potential_operation_assessment_version(assessment_id))
potential_operation_workflows:
CREATE TABLE potential_operation_workflows(
candidate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, canonical_run_id TEXT NOT NULL, canonical_tier TEXT NOT NULL, priority_rank INTEGER NOT NULL, operational_likeness REAL NOT NULL, activity_score REAL NOT NULL, priority_score REAL NOT NULL, workflow_status TEXT NOT NULL, proposed_name TEXT, parent_mechanism TEXT, latest_verdict TEXT, principal_gap TEXT, next_action TEXT, rpc_requirement TEXT, related_operator_id TEXT, last_investigated_at INTEGER, provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
potential_operation_child_candidates: CREATE TABLE potential_operation_child_candidates(child_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,parent_candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,workflow_status TEXT NOT NULL,proposed_name TEXT NOT NULL,member_mints_json TEXT NOT NULL,provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
p3r_v2_candidate_membership: CREATE TABLE p3r_v2_candidate_membership (run_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, mint TEXT NOT NULL, membership_reason TEXT NOT NULL, provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,candidate_id,mint))

reference_populations: qualified candidate specifications and frozen membership/ranking artifacts
selected/alternative/rejected parent edges and atomic-flow populations for each candidate
immutable assessment versions, current pointer, assessment lineage and association bindings
workflow review/promotion/rejection states and canonical review/identity events
original source row identities, high-water marks and freshness generations; new fixture rowids are not equivalent
post_walkback: Installed _notify_living_after_walkback_commit dispatches after source commit; its failure cannot undo Walkback. Preserve reverse resolver, feature flag, source reader and atomic publisher.
prototype_limit: No discovery/promotion/assessment publication executed; schema presence and one known route do not certify unseen-operation discovery.
